method.note: Pace model, pit-loss sample, noise components and compound caps are all refitted with this circuit held out, so nothing shown here was fitted on the race it is shown against.
not_modelled: Overtaking and track position (D5). Cars pass freely on cumulative time.
Traffic on rejoin (D5). Projections are clean-air times and run optimistic for a car that would have been held up.
Safety cars are never predicted (Challenge 3). They are an assumption you supply, and the grid here assumes the cautions that actually occurred.
